verdict.rationale: Trilegal's Labour and Employment page claims a comprehensive practice covering compensation structuring, retention strategies, and employment due diligence, and a deal example shows IP/confidentiality protection in a CTO exit — but none of the evidence explicitly names offer letters, employment agreements, or invention-assignment/confidentiality agreement drafting as a documented service line. Missing for 10: explicit mention of offer letter templates, standard employment agreement drafting, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreement services as a formalized hiring-paperwork offering.
